programmes.t: Once Upon a Time in America
programmes.d: Sergio Leone's final film is the epic tale of the life of a Jewish gangster in New York.

In 1979 an Indian family moves to America with hopes of living the American Dream. While their 10-year-old boy Smith falls head over heels for the girl next door, his desire to become a "good old boy" propels him further away from his family's ideals.
